General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging

What is This Part?
This is the Rear Output Shaft OIL SEAL for the Transfer Case.
Goes behind the Flange on the Transfer Case that connects to the Drive Shaft leading to the Rear Differential.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Seal (Rear Output Shaft)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
